articles.title: India's Banks Are Offering NRIs Up to 7% on Dollar Deposits — and SBI's Leveraged Product Promises 11.25%
articles.excerpt: The RBI's decision to absorb hedging costs on foreign currency deposits has triggered rate hikes of up to 310 basis points, could draw $35–40 billion in inflows, and is quietly reshaping how Indian banks fund themselves.
articles.image_caption: Indian rupee notes — NRI deposit rates have surged after the RBI agreed to absorb currency hedging costs
articles.nri_angle: NRIs can now earn 6-7% on dollar deposits in India — more than US Treasuries — with the RBI absorbing all currency hedging costs through September, creating a rare and time-limited investment window.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India's Services Engine Just Hit Its Slowest Speed in 17 Months — and Hiring Has Nearly Stalled
articles.excerpt: The HSBC India Services PMI fell sharply to 57.4 in June as domestic demand weakened to its lowest in over two years, even as export orders offered a partial cushion
articles.image_caption: The Bombay Stock Exchange building on Dalal Street in Mumbai
articles.nri_angle: NRI investors watching the Wall Street GDP upgrades and FPI flow reversal should weigh them against the sharpest services sector deceleration in 17 months — if domestic demand and hiring stay weak, the earnings recovery that fund managers are banking on may not materialise.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: HCLTech Just Landed a $1.14 Billion AI Deal With a European Giant — Its Biggest in Three Years
articles.excerpt: The mega-contract to build an AI-driven digital workplace for a Fortune Global 50 firm is entirely new business, ends a three-year drought in large deals, and lifts the Nifty IT index on a day when global tech is still reeling.
articles.nri_angle: Directly relevant to the tens of thousands of Indian-origin IT professionals and NRI investors with exposure to Indian tech stocks — the deal signals that AI-led transformation is creating new revenue streams, not just destroying old ones.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Foreign Investors Just Poured a Record $3.4 Billion Into Indian Government Bonds — and a Bloomberg Index Entry Could Unlock Billions More
articles.excerpt: India's decision to scrap taxes on foreign bond investments, combined with falling oil prices and RBI reforms, has triggered the biggest monthly debt inflow on record and put Bloomberg Global Aggregate Index inclusion within reach
articles.image_caption: India's bond market is drawing record foreign investment after sweeping tax reforms
articles.nri_angle: NRI investors can now hold Indian sovereign bonds tax-free after India scrapped withholding and capital gains taxes, making the 6.7% yield one of the most attractive risk-adjusted returns in emerging markets.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: A Weak US Jobs Report Just Took a Fed Rate Hike Off the Table — and India's Markets Are Surging on the News
articles.excerpt: Nonfarm payrolls came in at just 57,000 against expectations of 115,000, sending the dollar to its biggest one-day drop in two months and pushing Indian equities back above the $5 trillion mark for the first time since the Iran crisis began.
articles.image_caption: The Bombay Stock Exchange building in Mumbai — India's equity market has reclaimed the $5 trillion valuation mark
articles.nri_angle: NRI investors with US-denominated earnings and India-allocated portfolios benefit directly from a weaker dollar and easing Fed rate fears — the macro backdrop for Indian equities is the most favourable it has been in months.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India's IT Giants Face Their Most Scrutinised Earnings Season in Years — and AI Is the Elephant in Every Boardroom
articles.excerpt: With the Nifty IT index down 33% from its February peak, TCS and Infosys are about to report June-quarter results that could determine whether the sector's correction is a buying opportunity or the start of a structural decline.
articles.image_caption: The Infosys campus in Bangalore — India's IT bellwether reports Q1 FY27 results on July 23
articles.nri_angle: NRI investors hold significant IT sector exposure and many work in the very industry under scrutiny — this earnings season is both a portfolio and career signal.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: Wall Street Just Raised India's Growth Forecast to 7% — the Sharpest Upward Revision in Over a Year
articles.excerpt: Bank of America, Crisil, and Goldman Sachs have all upgraded India's outlook in the span of a week, citing collapsing oil prices, the Iran peace deal, and a capex surge — while the rupee posts its first quarterly gain since early 2025
articles.image_caption: The Reserve Bank of India headquarters in Mumbai — the central bank's dollar-inflow measures have helped the rupee post its first quarterly gain in over a year
articles.nri_angle: Rupee stability means NRI equity and debt returns are no longer being eroded by currency depreciation; the wave of growth upgrades improves the case for India-linked portfolio allocations.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India Is 'Very, Very Close' to a Historic US Trade Deal — but a $500 Billion Target and New Tariffs Stand in the Way
articles.excerpt: As the India-UK CETA prepares to launch on July 15, Washington says a bilateral trade agreement with New Delhi is nearly done — while a proposed 12.5% forced-labour tariff threatens to complicate the final stretch
articles.image_caption: Commerce Minister Piyush Goyal and UK Trade Secretary Jonathan Reynolds sign the India-UK Comprehensive Economic and Trade Agreement
articles.nri_angle: A US deal could lower tariff costs on Indian exports and ease barriers for IT professionals, while the UK CETA eliminates double social security payments for NRIs in Britain
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India's SIP Investors Refuse to Blink — ₹30,000 Crore a Month Keeps Flowing Even as Equity Fund Inflows Drop 40%
articles.excerpt: Systematic investment plans held above ₹30,000 crore for three straight months through May 2026, absorbing a sharp lump-sum pullback and underlining a structural shift in how Indian retail money behaves.
articles.image_caption: The Phiroze Jeejeebhoy Towers, home of the Bombay Stock Exchange in Mumbai
articles.nri_angle: NRI investors who use SIP channels to invest in Indian mutual funds should note that the domestic retail floor is now structurally strong enough to cushion FII selling — a dynamic that reduces the kind of sharp drawdowns that used to punish long-distance investors.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk

articles.title: India Is Emerging as Asia's Safe Haven as the Global AI Selloff Crushes South Korea and Taiwan
articles.excerpt: With KOSPI plunging below 8,000 and foreigners dumping $137 billion of Asian equities in H1 2026, India's oil-fuelled rally and domestic-demand story are pulling global money in a new direction
articles.image_caption: The Bombay Stock Exchange building in Mumbai, home of the Sensex
articles.nri_angle: NRI investors with Asian market exposure face a historic rotation away from AI-heavy chip plays in Korea and Taiwan toward India, where oil collapse, rupee recovery, and domestic-demand sectors offer a compelling alternative.
articles.author: Diaspora Desk
